description: Add (positive) or deduct (negative) stock for one General Inventory product with a required reason; writes an inventoryAdjustments record exactly like the app's Adjust Stock dialog. QuailOS stock is a single farm-wide count (no per-location stock); an optional location is recorded in the reason text. Rejects results below zero unless allowNegative is true. Supports confirm and idempotencyKey.

allowNegative.description: Allow the resulting stock to go below zero (default false)

confirm.description: Set to true to commit, false for dry-run preview

location.description: Optional location label (e.g. Blossom, FBA); appended to the reason text

quantity.description: Whole-number change: positive adds, negative deducts (non-zero)

name: adjust_inventory_stock
